projects.title: Make Your House a Home
projects.description:
Upon entering the Kosovar market, the Austrian brick producing giant, Xella, selected us to produce, organize and design all of its communication and promotional needs.

Design and printed material

During our cooperation, we produced a large number of publications and other designed materials, strictly following the company's brand image rules.

These included catalogues, brochures, flyers, leaflets, posters, banners, as well as smaller promotional materials, gifts, etc. 

Need a home? Choose quality.
